scenarios.name: hidden_block_behind_opaque_wall
scenarios.setup: Agent faces an opaque wall; a distinctive block is directly behind it; involved chunks are loaded/simulated.
expected: Wall surface is observable.
Hidden block identity is not a current visual observation.
Space behind the wall is unknown rather than observed empty.
prohibited: Hidden block registry/state in policy-visible output.
Observed-absent claim for the occluded region.

scenarios.name: hidden_entity_behind_opaque_wall
scenarios.setup: An entity moves behind an opaque wall within server tracking/simulation range.
expected: No visual entity observation.
Permitted audio may appear if the entity emits an audible event.

scenarios.name: out_of_frustum_entity
scenarios.setup: An unobstructed entity is behind the agent's current look direction and inside distance bounds.
expected: Entity is absent from visual observations until the agent turns into the frustum.

scenarios.name: transparent_window
scenarios.setup: An entity is behind clear glass inside the declared frustum/range.
expected: Entity can be visually observed when client-equivalent presentation permits it.
Glass remains visible.
prohibited: Treating every intervening block as opaque.

scenarios.name: partial_opening_large_entity
scenarios.setup: A large entity is partly visible through a doorway or partial-block opening.
expected: Visibility follows the documented sample-point strategy and remains stable under regression testing.
prohibited: Center-point-only logic that hides obviously visible geometry without documented rationale.

scenarios.name: loaded_but_client_unavailable_chunk
scenarios.setup: A distant chunk stays loaded for server reasons but lies outside the agent's declared visual/client availability.
expected: No block/entity state is exposed.
Coverage is unknown.

scenarios.name: unloaded_remembered_location
scenarios.setup: Agent observes a chest, leaves until the location is unavailable, and the world changes while away.
expected: Old memory remains stale/provenanced.
Memory updates only after legitimate re-observation.
prohibited: Live server lookup refreshing unseen memory.

scenarios.name: darkness_or_fog_impairment
scenarios.setup: The same target is observed under normal and declared low-visibility/effect states.
expected: Visibility/quality changes according to the selected profile.
prohibited: Exact hidden light-engine/debug values in baseline policy input.

scenarios.name: sound_behind_wall
scenarios.setup: A sound source is visually occluded but inside client-equivalent audible range.
expected: Permitted audio cue is present.
Visual state remains hidden.
prohibited: Exact hidden source coordinates unless independently observed.

scenarios.name: sound_outside_range
scenarios.setup: A sound event occurs outside the equivalent client's audible/delivery range.
expected: No audio event is emitted to policy input.
prohibited: Server event existence leaking through diagnostics or empty-event metadata.

scenarios.name: chat_recipient_isolation
scenarios.setup: Send public chat, a DM to the agent, a DM between two other players, and a console/operator log line.
expected: Agent receives public chat and its addressed DM.

scenarios.name: own_vs_other_inventory
scenarios.setup: Agent and another player carry different hidden inventories while visibly holding/equipping selected items.
expected: Own inventory is available.
Visible held/equipped items of the other player may be observed.

scenarios.name: evaluator_target_isolation
scenarios.setup: Evaluator knows exact target coordinates/labels for scoring.
expected: Evaluator can score using privileged state.
Policy view omits target ground truth.
prohibited: Evaluator target coordinates or labels in policy message/tensor.

scenarios.name: protocol_metadata_masking
scenarios.setup: Observation envelope contains schema, sequence, trace and exact timing metadata.
expected: Transport/evaluator retains metadata.
Fields marked policy-hidden are absent from policy view.
prohibited: Accidental policy feature generation from hidden protocol metadata.

scenarios.name: recipe_registry_isolation
scenarios.setup: Server has a complete recipe registry; scenario does not enable recipe-book UI capability.
expected: Current crafting outcomes remain observable.

scenarios.name: mechanic_derived_through_wall_cue
scenarios.setup: A normal player-facing mechanic presents a through-wall cue, such as a supported glowing outline.
expected: The specific player-facing cue may be represented with provenance/reason.

scenarios.name: cross_agent_isolation
scenarios.setup: Two agents have different visibility, inventory, private chat and memory while sharing batching/runtime infrastructure.
expected: Each agent receives only its own permitted state.
prohibited: Any other-agent private/unseen field in the wrong policy input.
